rationale: The gate every scored repository must clear. Defaults are strict: a judged repository must answer every judged pair correctly. Each entry under `repos` is an admission that a defect shipped and is tracked - the same ratchet as corpus/known-failures.json. Numbers move one way only: a threshold is tightened when the engine improves, never loosened to make a run pass. Deleting an entry, by fixing the defect, is the only correct exit.

Polly.why: Two standing false positives, both present in every engine measured so far and both filed: unrelated C# parameter runs (BulkheadEngine/CacheEngine) clustered on shape alone, and a four-line assertion clustered with a whole 28-line test method. 4 of 6 judged pairs correct. Tighten to 100/0/0 when they are fixed.
